create_VideoReader: create a VideoReader instance to open a video file and access frames by index or iteration
use_VideoReader_get_frame: get a specific frame by index from a VideoReader using the get_frame method
use_VideoReader_cvt2frames: convert a video to individual frame images saved in an output directory using cvt2frames
use_frames2video: join frame images from a directory into a single video file using frames2video
use_Cache: create a fixed-capacity LRU Cache using OrderedDict to store and retrieve video frames
